name: Coda
description: Coda (now Superhuman Docs) is a doc and table workspace with a REST API for docs and rows.
auth_notes: Provided sources do not state what credential is sent on API calls.
gate_detail: Sources do not say how a developer obtains credentials or whether a free plan suffices; only a 'Free and Paid Workspaces' section heading appears, with no content.
api_scope: Docs API at base path https://coda.io/apis/v1: list/search/create/copy docs, share and publish, discover pages, tables and controls, read/insert/upsert/update/delete rows.
mcp_notes: Vendor's own API docs recommend the Superhuman Docs MCP server for AI tools; no URL given.
blocker_detail: Right product and a public REST API are confirmed, but the sources do not establish auth method or access prerequisites.

evidence.quote: The Superhuman Docs API is a RESTful API that lets you programmatically interact with data in Superhuman Docs (formerly Coda):
This API uses a base path of https://coda.io/apis/v1 .
you may also want to consider using the Superhuman Docs MCP server .

issues: No source states the auth method (likely a token, but not in sources).
No source states self-serve access terms or plan requirements.
Webhooks and sandbox are not mentioned.
S2-S6 are Packs admin pages or Coda Payments, a different product, and were ignored.
